tests.id: composite contexts respect expression boundaries, quoting and access syntax
tests.title: composite contexts respect expression boundaries, quoting and access syntax
tests.source:
test("composite contexts respect expression boundaries, quoting and access syntax", () => {
  for (const expression of [
    "vars.FLAG",
    "inputs.flag || vars.FLAG",
    "format('{0}', secrets.TOKEN)",
    "toJSON(needs.build.outputs.x)",
    "matrix.os",
    "strategy.job-index",
    "vars['FLAG']",
    "inputs.flag ||\n        vars.FLAG",
    "format('}}', secrets.TOKEN)",
    "VARS.FLAG",
    "toJSON(vars)",
    "needs",
  ])
    assert.equal(violations(composite(`\u0024{{ ${expression} }}`)).length, 1, expression);
  for (const body of [
    "# Caller passes vars.FLAG",
    "${{ inputs.flag }} ${{ github.repository }}",
    "${{ inputs.myvars.thing }}",
    "${{ inputs.vars }}",
    "${{ inputs . vars }}",
    "${{ format('vars.FLAG', inputs.flag) }}",
    "${{ 'it''s secrets.TOKEN' }}",
    "${{ 'example ${{ secrets.TOKEN }}' }}",
  ])
    assert.deepEqual(violations(composite(body)), [], body);
  assert.deepEqual(violations("runs:\n  using: node24\n  main: index.js\n# ${{ vars.FLAG }}"), []);
});

import { expect, test, type Locator, type Page } from '@playwright/test'
import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { demoCredentials } from './demo'
import { mainTable, setTheme } from './ui'

const shots = process.env.BRAIAN_CREATE_SHOTS

async function login(page: Page) {
  const demo = demoCredentials()
  await page.goto('/')
  await page.getByTestId('email').fill(demo.email)
  await page.getByTestId('password').fill(demo.password)
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in' }).click()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('workspace')).toBeVisible()
}

async function workspace(page: Page, name: RegExp) {
  await page.locator('nav.tabs').getByRole('button', { name }).click()
}

async function shootThemes(page: Page, opener: Locator, dialog: Locator, name: string) {
  if (!shots) return
  mkdirSync(shots, { recursive: true })
  for (const theme of ['dark', 'light'] as const) {
    if (await dialog.count()) {
      await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
      await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
    }
    await setTheme(page, theme)
    await opener.click()
    await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
    await dialog.screenshot({ path: `${shots}/${name}-${theme}.png` })
  }
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  await setTheme(page, 'dark')
}

/** Focus paints the control's own border, not a second ring outside it. */
async function expectFocusBorder(control: Locator) {
  const paint = await control.evaluate((el) => {
    const probe = document.createElement('span')
    probe.style.color = 'var(--accent)'
    document.body.append(probe)
    const accent = getComputedStyle(probe).color
    probe.remove()
    const style = getComputedStyle(el)
    return {
      outlineStyle: style.outlineStyle,
      outlineWidth: Number.parseFloat(style.outlineWidth) || 0,
      borderTopColor: style.borderTopColor,
      borderRightColor: style.borderRightColor,
      borderBottomColor: style.borderBottomColor,
      borderLeftColor: style.borderLeftColor,
      borderTopWidth: Number.parseFloat(style.borderTopWidth),
      boxShadow: style.boxShadow,
      accent,
    }
  })
  expect(paint.outlineStyle).toBe('none')
  expect(paint.outlineWidth).toBe(0)
  expect(paint.borderTopWidth).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  expect(paint.borderTopColor).toBe(paint.accent)
  expect(paint.borderRightColor).toBe(paint.accent)
  expect(paint.borderBottomColor).toBe(paint.accent)
  expect(paint.borderLeftColor).toBe(paint.accent)
  expect(paint.boxShadow).toBe('none')
}

async function trap(page: Page, dialog: Locator) {
  for (let step = 0; step < 8; step += 1) {
    await page.keyboard.press('Tab')
    const inside = await dialog.evaluate((node) => node.contains(document.activeElement))
    expect(inside).toBe(true)
  }
  await page.keyboard.press('Shift+Tab')
  const inside = await dialog.evaluate((node) => node.contains(document.activeElement))
  expect(inside).toBe(true)
}

async function rejectWrites(page: Page, url: string, hold: boolean) {
  let release: () => void = () => undefined
  const held = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    release = resolve
  })
  let finished = Promise.resolve()
  await page.route(url, async (route) => {
    if (route.request().method() !== 'POST') {
      await route.continue()
      return
    }
    let settle: () => void = () => undefined
    finished = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      settle = resolve
    })
    try {
      if (hold) await held
      await route.fulfill({
        status: 422,
        contentType: 'application/problem+json',
        body: JSON.stringify({ detail: 'number already exists' }),
      })
    } finally {
      settle()
    }
  })
  return async () => {
    release()
    await finished
    await page.unroute(url)
  }
}

async function fill(dialog: Locator, fields: Record<string, string>) {
  for (const [testId, value] of Object.entries(fields)) {
    await dialog.getByTestId(testId).fill(value)
  }
}

/**
 * Open, trap focus, Escape from the first field, Escape during a save,
 * Escape after a server error (values stay), Cancel, then a successful create.
 */
async function exercise(page: Page, options: {
  opener: Locator
  dialogTestId: string
  title: string
  shot: string
  firstField: string
  failure: Record<string, string>
  success: Record<string, string>
  route: string
  selected: Locator
}) {
  const { opener } = options
  await expect(opener).toBeVisible()
  const dialog = page.getByTestId(options.dialogTestId)
  await shootThemes(page, opener, dialog, options.shot)
  await opener.click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  await expect(dialog.getByRole('heading', { name: options.title })).toBeVisible()
  const first = dialog.getByTestId(options.firstField)
  await expect(first).toBeFocused()
  await expectFocusBorder(first)
  await trap(page, dialog)
  await first.click()
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(opener).toBeFocused()

  const stopHeld = await rejectWrites(page, options.route, true)
  await opener.click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  await fill(dialog, options.failure)
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId('create-object')).toBeDisabled()
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(opener).toBeFocused()
  await stopHeld()

  const stop = await rejectWrites(page, options.route, false)
  await opener.click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  await fill(dialog, options.failure)
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
  const alert = dialog.getByRole('alert')
  await expect(alert).toBeVisible()
  await expect(alert).toContainText('number already exists')
  if (shots && options.shot === 'new-product') {
    await dialog.screenshot({ path: `${shots}/server-error-dark.png` })
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
    await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
    await setTheme(page, 'light')
    await opener.click()
    await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
    await fill(dialog, options.failure)
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await expect(dialog.getByRole('alert')).toContainText('number already exists')
    await dialog.screenshot({ path: `${shots}/server-error-light.png` })
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
    await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
    await setTheme(page, 'dark')
    await opener.click()
    await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
    await fill(dialog, options.failure)
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await expect(dialog.getByRole('alert')).toContainText('number already exists')
  }
  for (const [testId, value] of Object.entries(options.failure)) {
    await expect(dialog.getByTestId(testId)).toHaveValue(value)
  }
  await dialog.getByTestId(options.firstField).focus()
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(opener).toBeFocused()
  await stop()

  await opener.click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  await fill(dialog, options.failure)
  await dialog.getByTestId('create-cancel').click()
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(opener).toBeFocused()

  await opener.click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  await fill(dialog, options.success)
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(options.selected).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 })
}

test('From type select stays readable in dark theme', async ({ page }) => {
  test.setTimeout(90_000)
  await login(page)
  await setTheme(page, 'dark')
  await modelTab(page, 'Link types')
  const table = page.getByTestId('link-types-table')
  await table.getByTestId('table-add-row').click()
  const dialog = page.getByTestId('create-dialog')
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  await expect(dialog.getByRole('heading', { name: 'New link type' })).toBeVisible()
  const from = dialog.getByTestId('link-type-from')
  await expect(from).toBeVisible()
  // Themed Select trigger — not a native <select> that paints white.
  await expect(from).toHaveRole('combobox')
  const paint = await from.evaluate((el) => {
    const style = getComputedStyle(el)
    const probe = document.createElement('span')
    probe.style.color = 'var(--text)'
    document.body.append(probe)
    const text = getComputedStyle(probe).color
    probe.remove()
    return {
      color: style.color,
      background: style.backgroundColor,
      text,
      tag: el.tagName,
    }
  })
  expect(paint.tag).toBe('BUTTON')
  expect(paint.color).toBe(paint.text)
  expect(paint.background).not.toBe('rgb(255, 255, 255)')
  await from.click()
  const list = page.getByTestId('link-type-from-list')
  await expect(list).toBeVisible()
  const listPaint = await list.evaluate((el) => {
    const style = getComputedStyle(el)
    const probe = document.createElement('span')
    probe.style.color = 'var(--raised)'
    document.body.append(probe)
    const raised = getComputedStyle(probe).color
    probe.remove()
    return { background: style.backgroundColor, raised }
  })
  expect(listPaint.background).toBe(listPaint.raised)
  expect(listPaint.background).not.toBe('rgb(255, 255, 255)')
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
})

test('Link types create dialog', async ({ page }) => {
  test.setTimeout(120_000)
  await login(page)
  await modelTab(page, 'Link types')
  const table = page.getByTestId('link-types-table')
  const suffix = Date.now().toString().slice(-6)
  const key = `bundled_${suffix}`
  const failureFields = {
    'new-name': 'Duplicate link',
    'link-type-from-label': 'Duplicate out',
    'link-type-to-label': 'Duplicate in',
  }
  const successFields = {
    'new-name': `Bundled ${suffix}`,
    'link-type-from-label': 'Bundled out',
    'link-type-to-label': 'Bundled in',
  }
  const linkTypeDialogReady = async (dialog: Locator) => {
    await dialog.getByTestId('link-type-from').click()
    await page.getByRole('option', { name: 'product' }).click()
    await dialog.getByTestId('link-type-to').click()
    await page.getByRole('option', { name: 'product' }).click()
  }
  const opener = table.getByTestId('table-add-row')
  await expect(opener).toBeVisible()
  const dialog = page.getByTestId('create-dialog')
  await shootThemes(page, opener, dialog, 'new-link-type')
  await opener.click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  await expect(dialog.getByRole('heading', { name: 'New link type' })).toBeVisible()
  const first = dialog.getByTestId('new-name')
  await expect(first).toBeFocused()
  await expectFocusBorder(first)
  await trap(page, dialog)
  await first.click()
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(opener).toBeFocused()

  const stop = await rejectWrites(page, '**/v1/model/draft/steps', false)
  await opener.click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  await fill(dialog, failureFields)
  await linkTypeDialogReady(dialog)
  await dialog.getByTestId('create-object').click()
  const alert = dialog.getByRole('alert')
  await expect(alert).toBeVisible()
  await expect(alert).toContainText('number already exists')
  for (const [testId, value] of Object.entries(failureFields)) {
    await expect(dialog.getByTestId(testId)).toHaveValue(value)
  }
  await dialog.getByTestId('new-name').focus()
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(opener).toBeFocused()
  await stop()

  await opener.click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  await fill(dialog, failureFields)
  await linkTypeDialogReady(dialog)
  await dialog.getByTestId('create-cancel').click()
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(opener).toBeFocused()

  await opener.click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  await fill(dialog, successFields)
  await linkTypeDialogReady(dialog)
  await dialog.getByTestId('create-object').click()
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  const selected = table.locator(`[data-row-id="${key}"]`)
  await expect(selected).toBeVisible()
  await expect(selected).toHaveClass(/\bon\b/)
})

helpers.source:
async function expectFocusBorder(control: Locator) {
  const paint = await control.evaluate((el) => {
    const probe = document.createElement('span')
    probe.style.color = 'var(--accent)'
    document.body.append(probe)
    const accent = getComputedStyle(probe).color
    probe.remove()
    const style = getComputedStyle(el)
    return {
      outlineStyle: style.outlineStyle,
      outlineWidth: Number.parseFloat(style.outlineWidth) || 0,
      borderTopColor: style.borderTopColor,
      borderRightColor: style.borderRightColor,
      borderBottomColor: style.borderBottomColor,
      borderLeftColor: style.borderLeftColor,
      borderTopWidth: Number.parseFloat(style.borderTopWidth),
      boxShadow: style.boxShadow,
      accent,
    }
  })
  expect(paint.outlineStyle).toBe('none')
  expect(paint.outlineWidth).toBe(0)
  expect(paint.borderTopWidth).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  expect(paint.borderTopColor).toBe(paint.accent)
  expect(paint.borderRightColor).toBe(paint.accent)
  expect(paint.borderBottomColor).toBe(paint.accent)
  expect(paint.borderLeftColor).toBe(paint.accent)
  expect(paint.boxShadow).toBe('none')
}

async function exercise(page: Page, options: {
  opener: Locator
  dialogTestId: string
  title: string
  shot: string
  firstField: string
  failure: Record<string, string>
  success: Record<string, string>
  route: string
  selected: Locator
}) {
  const { opener } = options
  await expect(opener).toBeVisible()
  const dialog = page.getByTestId(options.dialogTestId)
  await shootThemes(page, opener, dialog, options.shot)
  await opener.click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  await expect(dialog.getByRole('heading', { name: options.title })).toBeVisible()
  const first = dialog.getByTestId(options.firstField)
  await expect(first).toBeFocused()
  await expectFocusBorder(first)
  await trap(page, dialog)
  await first.click()
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(opener).toBeFocused()

  const stopHeld = await rejectWrites(page, options.route, true)
  await opener.click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  await fill(dialog, options.failure)
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId('create-object')).toBeDisabled()
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(opener).toBeFocused()
  await stopHeld()

  const stop = await rejectWrites(page, options.route, false)
  await opener.click()
// ...

test('pairs with links two cheeses from the keyboard and the link type can be deleted', async ({ page }) => {
  test.setTimeout(180_000)
  await login(page)
  await command(page, 'Data model')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('data-model').first()).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByText('Link types').first()).toBeVisible()

  await command(page, 'New link type')
  await page.getByTestId('model-dialog-name').fill('Pairs with')
  await page.getByTestId('link-type-from').click()
  await page.getByRole('option', { name: 'article' }).click()
  await page.getByTestId('link-type-to').click()
  await page.getByRole('option', { name: 'article' }).click()
  await page.getByTestId('link-type-from-label').fill('Pairs with')
  await page.getByTestId('link-type-to-label').fill('Pairs with')
  await page.getByTestId('model-dialog-save').click()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('unsaved-changes')).toBeVisible()
  await page.keyboard.press('Control+S')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('review-dialog')).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('unsaved-changes')).toHaveCount(0)
  const linkTypeRow = page.getByTestId('link-types-table').locator('[data-row-id="pairs_with"]')
  await page.locator('.pane-tab', { hasText: 'Link types' }).first().click()
  await expect(linkTypeRow).toBeVisible()
  await linkTypeRow.click()
  await page.locator('.pane-tab', { hasText: 'Type attributes' }).first().click()
  const attributes = page.getByTestId('attribute-table')
  await expect(attributes).toBeVisible()
  await attributes.getByTestId('table-add-row').click()
  const create = page.getByTestId('create-dialog')
  await create.getByTestId('new-name').fill('Note')
  await create.getByTestId('create-object').click()
  await expect(attributes.locator('[data-key="note"]')).toBeVisible()
  await saveModelDraft(page)

  const productsTab = page.locator('nav.tabs').getByRole('button', { name: /^Products/ })
  await productsTab.click()
  await expect(productsTab).toHaveClass(/active/)
  await openObject(page, 'ART-CHED-200')
  const pairsSection = page.getByTestId('link-section').filter({ hasText: 'Pairs with' }).first()
  await pairsSection.getByTestId('add-link').focus()
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
  await page.getByTestId('link-search').fill('ART-CHED-400')
  await expect(page.getByRole('option').first()).toContainText('ART-CHED-400')
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
  const created = page.getByTestId('link-create-dialog')
  await expect(created).toBeVisible()
  await created.getByTestId('link-type-choice').selectOption('pairs_with:out')
  await created.getByTestId('link-field-note').fill('aged')
  await created.getByTestId('link-create-confirm').click()
  await expect(created).toBeHidden()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('link-row').filter({ hasText: 'ART-CHED-400' }).first()).toBeVisible()

  await openObject(page, 'ART-CHED-400')
  await expect(
    page.getByTestId('link-section').filter({ hasText: 'Pairs with' }).getByTestId('link-row').filter({ hasText: 'ART-CHED-200' }),
  ).toBeVisible()

  await command(page, 'Data model')
  await page.locator('.pane-tab', { hasText: 'Link types' }).first().click()
  await linkTypeRow.click()
  await command(page, 'Delete link type')
  const dialog = page.getByTestId('consequence')
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId('confirm-name')).toHaveCount(0)
  await page.getByTestId('confirm-delete').click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeHidden()
  await expect(linkTypeRow).toHaveCount(0)
})

function cloze(
  lemmaId: string,
  clozeId: string,
  blankCase: string,
  form: string,
  frame = `${clozeId}-frame`,
): PracticeClozeItem {
  return {
    clozeId,
    lemmaId,
    sentenceFrameId: frame,
    sentence: 'Я бачу ___.',
    blankCase,
    form,
    clozeEn: 'I see it.',
    caseRule: {
      ruleId: `${blankCase}-rule`,
      case: blankCase,
      caseLabel: blankCase,
      trigger: 'trigger',
      triggerLabel: 'trigger',
      feedback: `trigger -> ${blankCase}`,

test(`cycle cards, cooldown, chart and navigation at ${width}px`, async ({ page, request, workspaceKey }) => {
      const headers = { 'X-Flow-Workspace': workspaceKey, 'X-Workspace-Key': workspaceKey }
      const bootstrap = await (await request.get('/api/bootstrap', { headers })).json()
      const team = bootstrap.teams[0] as { id: string; key: string }
      expect((await request.patch(`/api/teams/${team.id}/cycle-settings`, { headers, data: { enabled: true, autoCreate: true, durationWeeks: 3, cooldownWeeks: 2, upcomingCount: 1 } })).ok()).toBe(true)
      const data = await (await request.get('/api/bootstrap', { headers })).json()
      const cycles = data.cycles as { id: string; number: number; startsAt: string; endsAt: string }[]
      const first = cycles.find(cycle => cycle.number === 1)!
      const next = cycles.find(cycle => cycle.number === 2)!
      expect((await request.patch(`/api/teams/${team.id}/cycle-settings`, { headers, data: { autoCreate: false } })).ok()).toBe(true)
      expect((await request.patch(`/api/cycles/${first.id}`, { headers, data: { status: 'completed', name: '[mobile] Finished cycle' } })).ok()).toBe(true)
      expect((await request.patch(`/api/cycles/${next.id}`, { headers, data: { name: '[mobile] Next cycle' } })).ok()).toBe(true)
      expect((await request.post('/api/issues', { headers, data: { title: '[mobile] Planned work', teamId: team.id, cycleId: first.id, stateId: 'state_todo' } })).status()).toBe(201)
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: width === 390 ? 844 : 667 })
      await page.goto(`/${workspaceKey}/team/${team.key}/cycles`)
      const completed = page.getByTestId('cycle-timeline-1')
      const upcoming = page.getByTestId('cycle-timeline-2')
      await expect(completed).toBeVisible()
      expect((await upcoming.boundingBox())?.y).toBe(44)
      expect((await upcoming.boundingBox())?.height).toBe(70)
      expect((await completed.boundingBox())?.y).toBe(164)
      expect((await completed.boundingBox())?.height).toBe(419)
      await expect(page.locator('.flow-cycle-cooldown')).toContainText('2 weeks cooldown')
      await expect(completed.locator('.is-scope strong')).toHaveText('1')
      await expect(completed.locator('.cycle-timeline-metric-label')).toHaveText(['Scope', 'Started', 'Completed'])
      await expect(completed.locator('.estimate-icon')).toHaveCount(0)
      const chart = completed.getByRole('img')
      expect((await chart.boundingBox())?.width).toBe(width - 112)
      await expect.poll(() => chart.evaluate(node => {
        const canvas = node as HTMLCanvasElement
        return canvas.getContext('2d')!.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height).data.some((value, index) => index % 4 === 3 && value > 0)
      })).toBe(true)
      expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth)).toBe(true)

      await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/cycle\/2(?:\/|$)/)
      await page.goBack()
      await page.getByTestId('cycle-timeline-1').click()
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/cycle\/1(?:\/|$)/)
    })

tests.id: MultiSpawnStartupPage — the real page > initial toggle states: stored-true on, migration-enable on + chip, undefined off, declined off with NO chip
tests.title: initial toggle states: stored-true on, migration-enable on + chip, undefined off, declined off with NO chip
tests.source:
it('initial toggle states: stored-true on, migration-enable on + chip, undefined off, declined off with NO chip', () => {
    CONFIG.configs = [
      cfg('stored-on', { allowMultiSpawn: true }),
      cfg('migrating'),
      cfg('untouched'),
      cfg('declined', { allowMultiSpawn: false }),
    ]
    SESSIONS.sessions = [
      sess('m1', 'migrating'), sess('m2', 'migrating'),
      sess('d1', 'declined'), sess('d2', 'declined'), sess('d3', 'declined'),
    ]
    render()
    expect(toggleEl('stored-on').getAttribute('aria-checked')).toBe('true')
    expect(toggleEl('migrating').getAttribute('aria-checked')).toBe('true')
    expect(toggleEl('untouched').getAttribute('aria-checked')).toBe('false')
    expect(toggleEl('declined').getAttribute('aria-checked')).toBe('false')
    expect(chipEl('migrating')!.textContent).toContain('auto · 2 copies found')
    // The decline is the load-bearing one: three copies are live and it still
    // renders OFF with no chip, because the migration promised not to touch it.
    expect(chipEl('declined')).toBeNull()
    expect(chipEl('stored-on')).toBeNull()
  })

tests.id: MultiSpawnStartupPage — the real page > a flip survives a re-render — user decisions outrank the derived state
tests.title: a flip survives a re-render — user decisions outrank the derived state
tests.source:
it('a flip survives a re-render — user decisions outrank the derived state', () => {
    CONFIG.configs = [cfg('a')]
    SESSIONS.sessions = [sess('s1', 'a'), sess('s2', 'a')]
    render()
    expect(toggleEl('a').getAttribute('aria-checked')).toBe('true')
    click(toggleEl('a'))
    expect(toggleEl('a').getAttribute('aria-checked')).toBe('false')
    // A session finishing its restore re-derives every row; the decline stays.
    SESSIONS.sessions = [...SESSIONS.sessions, sess('s3', 'a')]
    render()
    expect(toggleEl('a').getAttribute('aria-checked')).toBe('false')
  })

tests.id: AnalyticsOutboxHandler > should give a replayed outbox row the uuid it had the first time
tests.title: should give a replayed outbox row the uuid it had the first time
tests.source:
it("should give a replayed outbox row the uuid it had the first time", async () => {
    const first = createHandler(USR_A_GRANTED)
    spyOn(OutboxRepository, "fetchAfterId").mockResolvedValue([messageCreatedEvent({ id: 7n })] as any)
    first.handler.handle()
    await first.completed

    const replay = createHandler(USR_A_GRANTED)
    spyOn(OutboxRepository, "fetchAfterId").mockResolvedValue([
      messageCreatedEvent({ id: 7n }),
      messageCreatedEvent({ id: 8n }),
    ] as any)
    replay.handler.handle()
    await replay.completed

    const original = first.captureEvent.mock.calls[0][0].uuid
    expect(replay.captureEvent.mock.calls[0][0].uuid).toBe(original)
    expect(replay.captureEvent.mock.calls[1][0].uuid).not.toBe(original)
    expect(original).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-5[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/)
  })
